summary: As of October 30, 2026, junk-bond spreads are 3.44 percentage points, +0.06 percentage points over five trading days, and the junk-versus-safe gap is 2.50 percentage points. VIX is 19.42 and the 3-month VIX is 20.78, so near-term fear is below the 3-month reading. The Nasdaq-100 is -9.1 percent from its trailing high, semiconductors are +0.6 percent versus their 200-day average, and 70 percent of the 30-name list is above its own 200-day average.
what_would_change_this: The headline would leave risk-on if junk spreads reached 4.50 percentage points, near-term volatility rose above the 3-month reading by more than half a point, or the Nasdaq-100 fell more than 10 percent below its trailing high.
